Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking this — our executive leadership team is only available in a very narrow window while they’re traveling next week. Can Redwood do a live demo on Tuesday, 25 May at 07:00 AM ET (I know that’s early)? If not, Wednesday 07:30 AM ET would also work. Best,

Hi Samir —

Appreciate the heads-up. Two things to flag on our side: 

1) EU engineering has a team scheduling policy that prevents recurring meetings before 09:00 CEST and we try to avoid one-off exceptions without manager sign-off (local labor rules + on-call fairness).
2) There’s a DST synchronization quirk this spring: US already shifted and parts of EU switch a week later, which briefly shifts the usual offset by one hour. That’s what’s been tripping up a few customers this month.

Given that, our recommended live options that preserve EU-eng attendance are:
- Tue 25 May, 08:00 ET / 14:00 CEST — fully staffed, live engineers (preferred)
- Wed 26 May, 07:30 ET / 13:30 CEST — borderline for EU team but doable if we confirm now

If you absolutely need Tue/Wed at 07:00–07:30 ET, we can do a one-time on-call workaround: an on-call engineer can join at 07:00 ET to run the high-level flow and we will record the session + schedule a follow-up deep-dive with EU engineering during EU business hours. That requires an overtime/curfew waiver and sign-off (I’ve attached an internal availability grid so you can see who would be impacted).

Attached: availability-grid.csv (engineer availability + curfew flags).

Which of these would work for your execs? If you confirm 08:00 ET I’ll send a calendar invite with EU engineering pinned. If you must have 07:00 ET, please confirm and I’ll start the internal approval.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
